knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The method is chosen after identification and screening, and the least aggressive method that does the job comes first.
Heat can lift veneer and soften heat-sensitive adhesive, so heat is tested on a hidden area first.
Residue is collected and disposed of as the SDS and local rules set out. A drain is not the approved route.

practicalCriteria: Method and reason recorded before work starts
Hidden-area test completed and recorded before visible-surface work
Veneer not sanded through, and heat not used near veneer edges without a test
Residue removed and waste disposed of as the procedure sets out
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80% or higher. With three checks this means all three must be correct. Practical sign-off is separate: every practical criterion must be observed and met by the assessor. A knowledge pass is not practical competence and does not count toward sign-off.
stopWorkCriteria: Stripping started on an unscreened or suspect finish
Heat used near veneer without a test
